changelog:
Initial release of the CapCut skill.

- Organizes information from CapCut’s official homepage, templates, features, help center, and pricing pages.
- Focuses on summarizing template types, editing features, export options, support info, and subscription details.
- Does not support account operations, copyright bypassing, paid resource downloads, or API calls.
- Only processes publicly available content and clearly states commercial and copyright boundaries.
- Prioritizes official sources and maintains compliance with platform rules and data privacy.
